🎥🎬: Breaking Bear (2026)

Three bear siblings wake from hibernation to discover that their forest home is being destroyed by humans and threatened by gas companies using fracking. Desperate to save their home, the dysfunctional family decides to enter the criminal world and start selling drugs to raise enough money to fight back. 

Their operation quickly grows beyond their control as they recruit other forest animals and build a drug empire. But success brings dangerous enemies, including rival criminals, biker gangs, oil interests, and a ruthless wolf pack.

What starts as a desperate attempt to protect their home turns into a chaotic criminal war, forcing the bears to navigate betrayal, violence, and their own dysfunctional family dynamics while fighting to save the forest.

source_details.synopsis: Breaking Bear is an American-Canadian adult animated dark comedy crime television series created by Julien Nitzberg for Tubi. Featuring the voices of Brendan Fraser, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Annie Murphy, Elizabeth Hurley and Josh Gad, it parodies mobster films and other crime fiction, including the television series Breaking Bad. The first season premiered on July 24, 2026, and the remaining episodes were released on July 31, 2026.
